claim_scope: Train-only one-record oracle capacity diagnostic of a physical-head neuron-linear-transformation span. Oracle coefficients are not an online adapter and are forbidden for deployment.
hypothesis: Replacing the rejected branch-trunk span with the 64 highest-energy learned physical-head channel contributions will raise 5%-trust-capped oracle future-field improvement from 0.0483% to at least 1% on the same update-13650 Marmousi development record.
expected_mechanism: The last physical head directly synthesizes local pressure structure. Channel-wise output contributions therefore span corrections closer to the predicted field than the low-capacity branch-trunk term, while top-energy selection uses only the frozen prediction and not truth.
conceptual_variable: correction basis only: branch-trunk rank contributions versus physical-head channel contributions
primary_metric: Trust-capped oracle future-field relative-L2 improvement over the unadapted update-13650 prediction.

acceptance.interpretation_if_pass: retain physical-head NLT span and develop a causal/meta-learned coefficient predictor
acceptance.interpretation_if_fail: stop frozen internal-feature spans and train an explicit parent-error basis offline

failure_signal: Reject on binding drift, non-finite output, effective-rank failure, process failure, non-train truth, or any validation/test_id access.

oracle.basis: final 1x1 physical-head output contribution of each penultimate channel across all 64 frequencies
oracle.selection: largest complete-coefficient L2 norm using frozen parent activations only
oracle.objective: weighted leading-64-bin coefficient error from complete train truth

rollback: This diagnostic changes no checkpoint or deployed adapter. Preserve all prior artifacts and discard oracle coefficients after reporting capacity.
